_meta.title: Healthcare capital markets — public-source interim dataset (Option 2)
_meta.purpose: Replaces the unavailable PitchBook monthly aggregate. Quarterly, publicly-cited, multi-source triangulated + adversarially verified (workflow wf_a25d77a4, 2026-06-01).
_meta.granularity: QUARTERLY (+ FY annual baselines). NO monthly source exists in the free set — the old PitchBook monthly cadence cannot be reproduced.
_meta.mandatory_badges: Every figure carries: measure (upfront-cash | incl-contingents | announced-biobucks | proceeds | raised), geography (US-only | global), source_tier (HIGH primary | MEDIUM secondary).
_meta.no_rating: Figures only — no sell-side stock rating adopted (research-data.md MEDIUM-tier rule).
known_gaps: Medtech M&A: no quarterly free source — only Bain FY2025 PARTIAL-YEAR (Jan-Nov) ~$80B. Render as single partial-FY annotation, never faked quarterly.
Monthly granularity: none — all sources quarterly/annual.
HK/China healthcare IPO: ZERO coverage in US public sources (Renaissance/JPM are US-listed only) — material blind spot for a CMS HK desk. Candidate fill: iFind (connected) for A-share/HK IPO.
Quarterly digital-health M&A $ aggregate: not citable (CB Insights gives count only).
Full Q1'25->Q1'26 quarterly run: only YoY endpoints in hand; Q2-Q4 2025 need per-publisher archive backfill.
